{{Vanilla|Coal Ore}}
{{Infobox auto}}
'''Coal Deposit''' is the renamed coal ore.

The deepslate variant is '''deepslate coal deposit'''.

== Obtaining ==
=== Natural generation ===
As vanilla, plus large veins (size 17, 30 attempts per chunk) between the world bottom and y=0 under [[Biomes|deserts]].

=== Breaking ===
Mined with a pickaxe (see [[Tools#Mining levels]]), it drops 1–2 coal (2–4 from the deepslate variant), affected by Fortune and electrum. Silk Touch drops the block.<ref>{{Source|MF_datapack/data/minecraft/loot_table/blocks/coal_ore.json}}</ref>
